Subject: Re: Demo confirmation — May 6 at 10:00 CEST

Hi Anna — thanks for the note and the agenda. Quick apology up front: our calendar system defaulted the event to ET when the invite was created, and that may have caused the 07:00/10:00 discrepancy you're seeing.

To be explicit: the meeting owner originally entered 10:00 in CET/CEST, but the invite sent from our side propagated as 10:00 ET in some recipients' calendars. That explains why Michael is seeing an early morning time. I’m sorry for the confusion.

We can do either:
- Keep the original slot but reissue the invite explicitly set to 10:00 CEST (which would be 18:00 SGT/JST for APAC) — that works if Michael is ok with an evening slot.
- Or move to an overlapping slot that’s friendlier for APAC — e.g., 08:00 CEST (16:00 SGT) or 14:00 CEST (22:00 SGT) — both are workable for our demo team.

If Michael or ops prefer, we can also run a split session: a focused technical overlap with Michael plus a separate short exec walkthrough for EU buyers. I want to avoid travel day conflicts too — Karthik, Soojin, can you confirm availability?

I’ll reattach the walkthrough deck and send a corrected calendar invite (explicit timezone) once we agree.

—
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

Hi all — quick note from the ops side: Michael has a travel blackout May 6–8 (customer site visit in APAC) so evening slots for him on May 6 are not possible. He can do the later overlap on May 7 (APAC morning) or May 12 the following week.

If we keep May 6 for EU execs, I can run the technical deep dive with Karthik and the EU team and record the session for Michael, but given this is a configuration-sensitive demo (routing + fallback), his presence would be helpful for the APAC cutover discussion.

Proposals that would work for everyone internally:
- Option A: Move to Thu May 8, 09:00 CEST — Michael joins at 16:00 SGT (preferred by Stellar ops)
- Option B: Wed May 7, 14:00 CEST — later evening for APAC but within Michael’s constrained window
- Option C: Keep May 6, run split sessions (EU 10:00 CEST; APAC-specific sync recorded + 1:1 later)

I’ll let Priyom pick the recommended path — lean toward Option A given travel.

Thanks —
Soojin
